title: To the Yield
tagline: Formal duels with real weapons, fought to the yield. Nobody dies.
description:
NPCs can agree to a duel with the player, or challenge the player to one. The duel is fought with whatever weapons each side carries, until one of them yields or goes down; both are protected, so nobody dies. The player confirms every duel in a message box and yields by sheathing their weapon. SkyrimNet hears how each duel ended, so NPCs remember who won.

**Requires:** ToTheYield.esp (shipped with this mod), PapyrusUtil, powerofthree's Papyrus Extender.
author: whyregister
